messages:
maria: Heads up — saw a spike in fncall schema rejections on routeId=checkout_v2, ~5% of invocations in the last hour. Logs only show "validation.fail" though, no reason tag in the dashboard. anyone tracking?
cheng: Yup, noticed it too. Payment adapter is returning an array where we expect an object for `items`. Right now runtime increments validation.fail metric but doesn't surface the specific shape reason (enum vs type vs missing required).
sam: Can we add a reason_code field to the validation metric? e.g. reason_code=enum_mismatch / missing_key / array_instead_of_object. That would make dashboards actionable without digging logs.
olga: I like reason_code + a small blacklist of noisy customers. Also: if we introduce a soft-fallback (convert to free-text or degen route) we need clear billing attribution. Currently fallback routing charges to the final model and it skews cost reports.
maria: Agreed. Two issues: 1) telemetry granularity (reason_code), 2) UX for rollouts (console toggle for soft-fallback per-cust / per-route).
cheng: Implementation notes: runtime already produces a ValidationDetail proto but we only persist a generic flag. We can add an enum field and tag traces with it. Minimal change: emit metric `fncall.validation.reason` with tags {route, reason_code, is_fallback}.
sam: Good. For dashboards, please bucket by reason_code and also by adapter_name. Example query: `sum by (reason_code, adapter) (rate(fncall_validation_count[5m]))`
maria: Console: add toggle labelled "Soft-fallback on schema failure" with options: OFF / SOFT (fallback to free-text) / STRICT (reject). Toggle should default to STRICT for new accounts. Add rationale tooltip: "SOFT preserves UX at cost of potential quality regressions".
olga: UX ask: when SOFT is enabled show a sampling link to raw payloads (redacted) and a way to mark an adapter as tolerated. Also add a per-customer cap on soft-fallback rate so platform teams can avoid runaway billing.
cheng: One edge: if we soft-fallback and route to degen model, attribution should create two metrics: tokens_charged_primary and tokens_charged_fallback and an allocation tag `route_override=degen`. Otherwise billing/usage views break.
sam: Dev work: add reason_code enum, emit metric, wire into existing alerts. Ops work: add retention for validation traces x7d. Console work: toggle + sampling link + quota cap UI.
maria: Quick patch idea for runtime logging (pseudo):
```json
{"validation": {"ok": false, "reason_code": "array_instead_of_object", "path": "items"}}
```
cheng: We'll need to be careful with PII in the raw payloads. Redaction rule: remove fields named card_number, ssn, email before storing any trace. Add legal review if we keep >24h.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of fncall-metrics v2 succeeded on 3 hosts (canary=5%). :white_check_mark:
maria: Plan for rollout: canary to 5% of routes next Tue, enable reason_code telemetry first (no console toggle yet), then console toggle soft-fallback behind feature-flag and roll to 10% customers after we verify billing split.
olga: Action item: add a console annotation explaining cost impact and a prominent link to per-customer soft-fallback cap.
sam: I'll own the Grafana dashboard panels and the alert tweak. Will add note on runbook for investigating repeated enum_mismatch spikes.
cheng: I'll PR runtime change today (emit enum), include a migration note for downstream consumers. Also adding unit tests for adapter error shapes.
maria: TL;DR ACTIONS: cheng -> instrument reason_code enum + redaction; sam -> dashboard + alert changes; olga -> console UX copy + cap; maria -> schedule canary and runbook update. Target: Friday 12:00 UTC for dashboard + telemetry, Tue for controlled toggle rollout. :calendar:
sam: Ack. I'll also add a small sampled log link in the runbook so SREs can triage without asking devs for samples. :+1:
cheng: Sending PR link when ready.
maria: Thanks all. If anyone sees new validation.fail spikes after deploy ping here. :eyes:
